rationale: C01 is the expressly identified prior notice and is nearly verbatim across the full letter. The child preserves the same statutory explanation, notice-transmission formula, unresolved-crisis assessment, description of Libya's support for terrorism, threat finding, and determination to retain economic-pressure authorities, changing principally the anniversary date and references needed for the new President. C03 is an earlier version of the same Libya continuation template. C05 uses the same continuation-letter structure for Iran but lacks the Libya-specific language shared by C01 and C03.
